summary: TypeScript + React when a rich UI is required; choose Hono/Express/Fastify with evidence; PostgreSQL and Drizzle only when useful.
tradeoffs: Avoid unnecessary React, ORM and database for APIs

summary: Python with FastAPI or other fit-for-purpose framework; persistence only as needed.
tradeoffs: Good for Python teams and models
Frontend can be separate or absent

summary: Python + selected data stack, reproducible experiments and baselines; deployment optional.
tradeoffs: Not every analysis needs MLflow, FastAPI or GPU

summary: SQL/Python with validated ingestion, contracts, schedules and lineage; orchestration only if justified.
Bash/Python scripts, scheduled jobs and minimal dependencies. Containerize only if useful.
tradeoffs: Needs robust logging and re-run safety

summary: Operational scripts and observability integrated with existing infrastructure; read-only first.
One agent with tools first; add durable orchestration or multiple agents only for demonstrated needs.
tradeoffs: Beware cost, complex state and prompt injection

summary: Compare React Native, Flutter, native SDKs against offline/UX/device requirements.
Single executable or small CLI with tests, clear commands, safe config and no server by default.
tradeoffs: No UI or server if not needed

summary: Prefer existing repository language, framework and operational conventions unless change is justified.
tradeoffs: Check if legacy security or support status requires change
